This page is printed page 502 and opens the whole book's ANSWERS section with the answers to CHAPTER 9 (Ray Optics), i.e. a different chapter's answer key that happens to sit inside this chapter's PDF file. The step forbids treating back matter as this chapter's content, but the A2 schema requires at least one block (zero-block outputs are rejected by schema validation, as happened repeatedly to BIO11L-ch01-p001 and CHE12O-ch15-p014), so the page is transcribed faithfully and labelled here instead of being silently absorbed: nothing on pages 34 onwards of this file is Semiconductor Electronics content and none of it should be cut into chapter-14 passages downstream. previous_page_last_block was null, so the continuation was judged from my own p033 output, which ended with Fig. 14.40; this page starts a new section, so no continuation. The displayed fraction line under 9.12 is scrambled in the text layer and is deferred to A2S as an equation block; inline formulas are written as the text layer spells them (e.g. 'r ~ 38' rather than the image's squiggle-equals, 'm2' for the squared metre).
